description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

Layer-0 uniform causal attention averages a 'is 1' feature over the 11 prompt positions (gives count k of ones); layer-0 MLP computes parity p=k mod 2 as a staircase of 10 ReLU-pair steps; head reads LN(p) vs LN(1-p). Layers 1-2 zeroed.
Same staircase circuit as V1 but MLP width d_ff=20 (exactly 2 ReLU units per threshold j=1..10, no unused units).
Staircase circuit with d_ff=20 and only ONE transformer block (layers 1-2 removed): layer-0 attention counts ones, layer-0 MLP computes parity.
Staircase circuit, one block, ONE attention head (n_heads=1, d_head=64) instead of 4; the count head is head 0 and the other heads do not exist.
Minimal width: d_model=9 (only residual dims 0-8 used: 4 token one-hots, count, parity, 1-parity), n_heads=1, one block, d_ff=20.
Minimal d_model=9 circuit with token one-hot scale ALPHA=1 (instead of 100): tests that the LayerNorm-aware threshold construction is exact even when LN is strongly nonlinear.

Minimal d_model=9 circuit with token one-hot scale ALPHA=0.01: LayerNorm epsilon (1e-5) is now comparable to the variance, so LN is far from scale-invariant. Thresholds are computed from the same LN formula, (200-sample eval only; not exhaustively checked.)

Minimal d_model=9 circuit with token one-hot scale ALPHA=1000: the residual is dominated by the constant '=' code, so LayerNorm is nearly linear. Same thresholds (computed exactly). 200-sample eval only; not exhaustively checked.

d_model=9, one block, one head, d_ff=10: MLP units are relu(u - us[j]) for j=0..9 (u = count feature at '=', us[j] its exact value for count j), one unit per knot; exact interpolation of k mod 2 at the 11 possible counts. 200-sample eval only at d_model=9; the same construction is exhaustively verified at d_model=4.
Ablation of ParityKnotD10: drop the 1-p residual dimension (USE_NPAR=False) so the head reads only the parity dim. Tests whether the complementary feature is needed.
ParityKnotD10 with the residual compressed to d_model=7: token one-hots in dims 0-3, count in dim 4, parity in dim 5, 1-parity in dim 6. Same 10-unit knot MLP.
ParityKnotD7 with token one-hot scale ALPHA=0.001: the LayerNorm epsilon dominates, so the knot values us[k] are computed from the exact LN formula including eps.
Staircase (ReLU-pair, d_ff=20) MLP on the d_model=4 shared-token-dim residual stream. Comparison with ParityKnotD4Shared (10 units).
ParityKnotD4Shared without the head rows that suppress '=' and '_' (logit rows 2, 3 left at zero). Tests whether the output head needs an explicit output mask.
ParityKnotD4Shared with n_heads=4 (d_head=1). Only head 0 is written; heads 1-3 have zero weights, so the attention still averages a single feature.
Knot circuit with d_ff=9: the last knot unit (j=9) is dropped. Exhaustive check: 1/2046 wrong (1111111111=), so the 200-sample eval (200/200) misses it.
ParityKnotD4Shared with n_layers=3: blocks 1 and 2 have all-zero weights (identity), so they contribute nothing; checks the circuit is unaffected by extra residual blocks.
ParityKnotD4Shared with n_layers=2: block 1 is all-zero (identity). Checks that a single extra zero block leaves the circuit unchanged.
ParityKnotD4Shared with token one-hot scale ALPHA=1 (one block). LayerNorm is no longer near-linear; the knot values us[k] are computed through the exact LN formula.
ParityKnotD4Shared with ALPHA=0.01. Exhaustive check: 12/2046 wrong (all with 9+ ones). Cause not verified; the 200-sample eval misses them.
ParityKnotD4Shared with ALPHA=0.001. Exhaustive check: 0/2046 wrong. The ALPHA=0.01 failures are therefore not monotone in ALPHA (cause not verified).
ParityKnotD4Shared with ALPHA=1e5 (very large one-hot scale): LayerNorm is essentially linear here; checks the knot circuit does not depend on how large ALPHA is.
ParityKnotD4Shared but the positional embeddings are left at random init (POS_ZERO=False). Tests how much the circuit relies on the absence of positional signal.
Staircase (d_ff=20) on the d_model=4 residual with M_SCALE=1 (ramps one count-gap wide). Exhaustive check: 0/2046 wrong, so the staircase is exact even with soft steps.
Staircase (d_ff=20) on the d_model=4 residual with M_SCALE=0.1: ramps are ten count-gaps wide, so adjacent counts are not separated. Exhaustive check: 1024/2046 wrong (0.51 on sample).
ParityKnotD4Shared with n_heads=2 (d_head=2). Only head 0 is written; head 1 has zero weights, so the count still comes from a single attention feature.
ParityKnotD4Shared with USE_NPAR=False: the 1-p dimension is dropped and the head reads only the parity dim. Repeats the d_model=9 ablation at d_model=4.
ParityKnotD4Shared with d_ff=12: the 10 knot units plus 2 unused units (zero weights). Checks that extra unused MLP width does not change the circuit.
ParityKnotD4Shared with ALPHA=10 (one block, d_ff=10). Checks the knot circuit at an intermediate one-hot scale.
Residual stream = token alphabet (d_model=4). Count/parity/1-parity reuse the token dims for '0', '_' and '1', which are unused at the '=' position. Same 10-unit knot MLP.
